question: For the first feasible chained Boolean systems at arity five and six, do the three fixed four-draw UNSAT packages refute under fixed-degree MutantXL closure by degree four while the fixed six-draw SAT package remains unrefuted?

claims.text: Each of the three registered four-draw cell packages receives one exact bounded-four, above-four, draw-dependent, unmeasured, or invalid classification, conditional on the six-draw satisfiable package and one-draw identity package.
claims.if_supported: Advance bounded cells to growing ell and n, matched external F4, and complete charged cost; retain every other presentation and scale question as open.
claims.if_not_supported: Reject only universal closure degree four at the exact completed cell; degree five and other formulations remain live.

claims.text: No elapsed-time, throughput, end-to-end ECDLP, asymptotic, or cryptographic-scale claim is in scope.

aa.not_applicable_reason: No clock, throughput, or relative-performance quantity is a metric; all decisions use exact algebraic replay and completion states.

positive.expected_detection: Each of exactly six expected control objects matches its registered cell/draw, retains a positive exact solution count, contains exactly the saturated degree-3 and degree-4 scan rows with measured_to=4, and reports neither XL nor closure refutation. A duplicate, missing degree, malformed object, or refutation invalidates the package.

negative.not_applicable_reason: The exactly-unsatisfiable systems are the registered scientific instances, not a sampled null population; their zero solution counts are checked before closure.

factors.name: source_build_and_caps
factors.value: One frozen commit, container digest, compiler, and three release binaries; four threads; degree four; 400000 columns; 32 GB address space.
factors.how: The registered source commit, clean matching instrument paths at a descendant execution ref, Cargo.lock, all transitive source, container/compiler identity, ladder/closure/analyzer binaries, sanitized environment, argv, protocol hash, and manifests are verified before every executable stage.

factors.name: draw_stream
factors.how: Three separate deterministic native generator calls, one per cell, retain the full strictly increasing unique draw-index prefix until both quotas are met. The audit requires draw indices below 4096, exact m/n/ell/n_vars, outcome/solution consistency, and the exact terminal both-quota rule; selection is numeric, never file-order or closure-outcome dependent.

factors.name: composite_evidence_packages
factors.value: Five export rows: one identity package (1 subprocess), one SAT package (6 subprocesses), and three cell-specific UNSAT packages (4 subprocesses each).
factors.how: The native analyzer retains and audits all 19 underlying subprocess histories, then emits exactly one deterministic logical row per package; a package is never represented by an arbitrary constituent subprocess.

factors.name: scientific_environment
factors.how: Every closure replay uses the exact allowlist. Inherited KIC_F4_*, KIC_GF2_*, F4_F2_*, tuning, debug, and thread variables are absent; the attempt metadata records the complete child environment.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Record CPU, memory, kernel, hypervisor, thread count, commit, binaries, and checkpoint segments; these facts cannot license a timing claim.

factors.name: execution_order
factors.value: identity, satisfiable controls, then cells in listed order and ascending numeric draw index
factors.how: Each detached job runs exactly one logical closure subprocess. Resumes import the prior durable tree before allocating an append-only attempt, reuse only that logical run's manifest-validated checkpoint directory, and invalidate wall time.

factors.name: checkout_and_durable_state
factors.value: Full repository checkout at an exact pushed descendant of the registered source commit; output root is exactly the absolute EPHEMERAL_OUT path.
factors.how: Path-dependency and build closure require the whole checkout, not a sparse path set. On resume, EPHEMERAL_RESUME_DIR is copied and hash-validated into an initially empty EPHEMERAL_OUT before any attempt starts; checkout-local output is refused on detached workers.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Exact computations run one at a time in increasing registered cell and committed draw order; order cannot change algebraic results and no clock is analyzed.

seed_derivation.note: dreg_ladder derives each cell stream from this seed, n, ell, and m; no replacement seed is allowed.

instance_sampling.rule: Each arm is one fixed composite package. The three candidate packages use the first four exact zero-solution records of their cell; the positive package uses the first two exact positive-solution records of each cell; the identity package contains only m4,n12,ell5,draw24. Draw selection is by ascending numeric index in an audited committed full prefix and fails if either cell quota is unavailable by draw 4095.

blinding.how: All outcomes are exact and the complete fixed sample is reported; no analyst choice or inferential comparison is present.

power.note: This is a finite exact classification of five registered composite packages, not a population-frequency or significance claim. The 19 underlying closure subprocesses remain individually visible in the analyzer summary.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Per-job admission budget only. Each detached job executes exactly one of 19 closure subprocesses and is separately capped at 24 hours; the three generator invocations are separate prerequisite jobs. No elapsed-time result is analyzed.

primary.name: Exact closure outcome
primary.definition: For an audited exactly-unsatisfiable draw: closure_le_4 only when one completed degree-3 or degree-4 row refutes; above_4 only when exactly one final object has no XL/closure refutation, measured_to=4, and a completed saturated degree-4 row; unmeasured for caps, timeout, OOM, missing degree, malformed output, or exhausted retry budget. Early completed refutation does not require a later degree-4 row.
primary.source: runs/unsat-*/attempts/* retained stdout/status/meta plus native summary.json

primary.name: Refuted satisfiable controls
primary.definition: Number of audited exact positive-solution controls for which XL or closure reports a refutation. A valid sound control requires exactly one output object for the exact cell/draw, degree-3 and degree-4 rows both present and saturated, measured_to=4, positive exact solutions, and no XL or closure refutation; duplicate, missing, malformed, or contradictory output invalidates the package.
primary.source: runs/control-*/attempts/* retained stdout/status/meta plus native summary.json

primary.definition: One iff exactly one m4,n12,ell5,draw24 output object passes structural checks and matches every historical algebraic field after excluding seconds, checkpoint segments, and source path; duplicates or malformed output invalidate the package.
primary.source: runs/identity-m4-n12-l5-d24/attempts/* retained stdout/status/meta and predecessor retained row

execution.queue: one exact logical subprocess per detached 32GB-or-larger CPU job, using a full repository checkout at an exact pushed descendant of the registered source commit

stopping_rules.rule: Run three restartable generator jobs, one deterministic stream per cell with --unsat 4 --min-sat 2. Each writes a temporary file, audits the complete unique strictly increasing numeric prefix and terminal both-quota condition, then atomically installs it; a validated existing cell is skipped, while an invalid partial is retained and generation fails. Select exactly the first four exact UNSAT plus first two exact SAT records by numeric draw index; never replace the seed or select by closure outcome.

Run one logical closure subprocess per detached job. Complete and analyze the identity replay and all six satisfiable controls before the twelve UNSAT scans; any algebraic identity mismatch, malformed/duplicate control, or refuted satisfiable control invalidates scientific interpretation and stops primary execution.

Each process is limited to 400000 columns, 32 billion address-space bytes, four threads, and 86400 seconds, with 60 seconds after TERM and at most four append-only attempts. A completed degree-3 or degree-4 refutation is closure_le_4. Above_4 requires no refutation, measured_to=4, and a present saturated degree-4 row. A successful exit alone, cap, OOM, timeout, corrupt checkpoint, malformed/duplicate/missing final object, missing required degree, or incomplete degree-four build is unmeasured (or invalid for a control), never above-four and never a disproof. Retryable interruption remains pending before attempt four and becomes terminal unmeasured at attempt four.

Never overwrite an attempt. Allocate runs/<logical-name>/attempts/<NNNN>, retain stdout, stderr, status and metadata for every invocation, reuse only the logical run's shared manifest-validated checkpoint, and write a final pointer only after the frozen native analyzer classifies the full history.

invalidation_rules: Any mismatch in the historical identity replay's algebraic fields invalidates the new cells until explained and a new protocol version is filed before rerun.
Any satisfiable control refuted by XL or closure invalidates that cell and the shared instrument; no primary conclusion is allowed.
A draw file generated before the protocol freeze or altered after its commit is inadmissible.
A resumed run whose wall time is interpreted as evidence is inadmissible; exact counters remain usable after manifest-validated restore.

Any executable stage whose registered source commit is not an ancestor, whose instrument or runner paths differ from that commit, or whose clean-tree, image/compiler, binary, or sanitized-child-environment identity fails is inadmissible.

Any detached run whose output root is not exactly the absolute EPHEMERAL_OUT path, or whose prior EPHEMERAL_RESUME_DIR tree was not copied and validated into an initially empty new output root before execution, is inadmissible.

Any overwritten attempt, lost retry, nonnumeric draw selection, duplicate draw index, skipped stream record, unexpected cell/shape, contradictory outcome/solution count, or status-only completion decision invalidates the affected package.

decision_rule.text: The frozen native analyzer audits all append-only attempts and emits exactly five logical package rows. For an UNSAT draw, closure_le_4 requires a completed refutation at degree 3 or 4; above_4 requires no refutation plus measured_to=4 and a saturated degree-4 row; everything incomplete or resource-censored is unmeasured, while malformed or contradictory evidence is invalid. Identity and all six controls must pass. Four closure_le_4 rows give bounded-four; a fully measured mixture gives draw-dependent; otherwise any valid above_4 row rejects universal four at that cell even if another UNSAT row is merely unmeasured; absent such a counterexample, any unmeasured constituent makes the package unmeasured. Invalid evidence makes interpretation invalid.
decision_rule.threshold: Five audited composite rows backed by all 19 retained closure subprocess histories: four classified UNSAT draws per cell, six sound SAT controls, and exact identity replay
decision_rule.statistic: Exact count of closure-by-four versus complete-no-refutation outcomes among four fixed draws per cell
decision_rule.interval: No sampling interval; finite exact registered draws only
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Exact closure degree category and instrument counters per completed draw; no standardized or timing effect size

graphs: Per-cell exact draw outcomes with unmeasured rows visible
Degree-four columns and closure word-operation counts for complete rows only

inadmissible: Calling timeout, OOM, cap, missing output, incomplete degree, or checkpoint corruption a failure of the mathematical mechanism
Generalizing three toy cells to constant degree at cryptographic scale or to another presentation
Using emitted seconds for a speed, scaling, or comparative claim
Hiding an extra draw, control failure, interrupted row, retry, or resume
Changing the seed, draw selection, cap, degree, or cell after seeing closure output
Treating process exit zero, a nonempty stdout file, or a final pointer as a scientific classification without frozen native-analyzer validation
Collapsing, overwriting, or omitting any of the 19 subprocess histories or any retry attempt when producing the five logical package rows
Launching a monolithic multi-draw detached job, a sparse checkout, an unpushed ref, a non-durable output root, or an inherited solver environment
Closing GG14, FGHR, symmetric, topology-dependent, degree-five, or end-to-end index-calculus leads from this experiment
